title: palette.json _comment mislabels the tie-vs-congested CVD distances per mode (values rotated)
evidence: _comment: "tie-vs-congested pair 105.0/202.1/236.5 deutan/protan/tritan — the pair is now IN both oracles". Running the shipped tools/derive_a11y_palettes.py on the shipped bytes prints: "== deutan pair report ==" ... "ok   tie-vs-congested  202.1 (48)"; "== protan pair report ==" ... "ok   tie-vs-congested  236.5 (48)"; "== tritan pair report ==" ... "ok   tie-vs-congested  105.0 (48)".
detail: The per-mode attribution is rotated: actual deutan=202.1, protan=236.5, tritan=105.0. All three clear the 48 threshold, so only the comment's mode-to-number mapping is wrong, not the verdict.
recommended_fix: Reorder the triple in the _comment to "202.1/236.5/105.0 deutan/protan/tritan" (matches the script's pair report).
